Thursday after dovish comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller triggered a sharp reversal in rate expectations, weakened the dollar and sent Treasury yields lower.

The catalyst came after Waller indicated he would favor keeping interest rates unchanged at the Fed's September 15-16 meeting if upcoming inflation data shows price pressures are cooling.
Following the remarks, the implied probability of a September rate hike fell by roughly
12 percentage points to 54.6%
. The U.S. dollar index dropped 0.5%, bond yields declined and gold climbed 2.3%, creating a more favorable liquidity backdrop for Bitcoin.
The rally also pushed Bitcoin through an important technical level.
BTC broke above

and remains upward-sloping, suggesting the broader trend is still intact.
But the speed of the rally also creates some risk. Bitcoin's 14-period RSI jumped to
, moving into overbought territory and increasing the possibility of a short-term pullback or retest of support.

The macro backdrop remains just as important. August jobs data, inflation readings and changing Fed expectations could quickly reshape the rate outlook.
One longer-term development is also worth watching: Bitcoin's
90-day correlation with gold has climbed to its highest level since 2020

, while its recent correlation with the S&P 500 has fallen close to zero. That strengthens the argument that investors are increasingly trading Bitcoin as a scarce monetary asset rather than simply another high-beta technology trade.

title: Bitcoin Rally Accelerates After Surprise Fed Signal
